reason: A DeepSeek Harness slash-command plugin for manually renaming the current conversation or generating a concise session title from selected conversation content.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /rename 斜杠命令，可直接设置当前会话标题，或根据对话内容生成标题。
summaries.en: Adds a /rename slash command to DeepSeek Harness for setting the current session title directly or generating one from the conversation.

capabilities: renames the current session title from explicit user input
reads selected conversation messages to generate a title when no name is provided
sends an auxiliary session-title request to the configured language model
